content: Hello, this is Clara from WanderWay Travel. How can I assist you today with your booking or deposit details?
Hi Clara, I wanted to confirm my deposit for the Paris hotel reservation. I sent €320 last night via PayPal, using my name, Daniel Ortega, and the reservation code PRT-7982.

Thanks, Daniel! I see your PayPal transfer of €320 linked to reservation PRT-7982 under Daniel Ortega's name. Payments made before midnight are prioritized for instant hotel confirmation, and you completed yours at 10:47 PM, great timing.
Will I get a confirmation email soon? My email is daniel.ortega87@mail.com, and the PayPal transaction ID is 4GL829ZKQ1A.
Yes, your confirmation will be sent directly to daniel.ortega87@mail.com within the next two hours. With transaction ID 4GL829ZKQ1A on file, the hotel can immediately verify your deposit.
Perfect. My check-in is July 13th, right? And the booking is for the Marais district hotel?
Correct, your reservation at Hôtel Lumière, Marais district, starts July 13th. The booking is under your passport number X2098765, matching our records.
Thanks, Clara. What if the PayPal payment is delayed or flagged?

If any delay occurs, just keep your PayPal receipt with transaction 4GL829ZKQ1A handy. Our finance team can escalate payment verification by referencing your booking code PRT-7982 and your full name, Daniel Ortega, to ensure no disruption to your check-in.
